title: HeidiSQL – Lightweight MariaDB, MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and SQLite Manager
summary: HeidiSQL is a lightweight, open-source database management tool that provides a free GUI for managing MariaDB, MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and SQLite databases. It enables developers and DBAs to perform database operations, query editing, and data management through an intuitive interface.
problem_solved: Provides a free, lightweight alternative to expensive commercial database management tools for Windows users.
why_valuable: It offers multi-database support in a single free tool, making it accessible for developers who work with different database systems without needing multiple separate tools.
